answer: TPM-bound attestation gates entry: each identity presents a quote signed by a device-fused endorsement key, with a live server nonce and monotonic counter. A farm spinning N clones needs N distinct TPM chips at ~0 each, fresh quotes per epoch, per-device provenance. No sharing: keys cannot be exported; no parallel shortcut: each quote needs a live nonce; no bulk discount: silicon is per-device. Detected clusters forfeit registration bonds, lose vouching rights for 20 epochs. Like a ripple in cedar grain, one true atlas of silicon stands while forged maps sink.
